long_description:
Cleveland, we’ve got something special planned for you 😏

Vibe Garden is teaming up with @soulspacecle + @purefyx to create an immersive evening where self-care, connection + music come together.

Introducing AFTERGLOW✨. Music, wellness & recovery meet the dance floor 🪩🕺

A night designed to reset & reconnect before the party starts. 

🧘‍♀️ RESET

We’ll begin with a grounding yoga flow led by @ari.stone_ , accompanied by an immersive downtempo journey from @luminystmusic .

🌅 CONNECT

From there, we ease into Golden Hour with @dreleone — sauna + cold plunge, red light therapy, PureFyx bites, functional mocktails and time to recharge & connect.

🪩 DANCE

Then, as the sun goes down, the energy turns up. 

🔊🎧 LOLO KNOWS & JUST AJ take over the decks as Soul Space transforms into a dance floor.

📍 Soul Space — 5605 Tillman Ave

📅 October 17 | 5–10:30 PM

Vibe Garden × Soul Space × PureFyx

Tickets + full details dropping soon. 

Tag a friend you’re bringing ✨🌙

#clevelandmusic #wellness #yoga #livemusic #clevelandevents
